about_the_game:
Turn your Twitch chat into a battle for dominance!

King of the Chat is an interactive Twitch overlay game that transforms your viewers into marble warriors fighting for the throne. By simply spending channel points, viewers can spawn marbles, drop into an exciting plinko-style challenge, earn points, and launch attacks to seize control of the throne.

This game runs itself automatically, keeping your chat lively, engaging, and even boosting revenue—all while you focus on your content. Whether it's channel points, bits, or subs, King of the Chat gives viewers fun ways to interact with your stream while helping you monetize effortlessly.

Let the battle begin! Will your viewers claim the throne or be toppled by the next challenger?

Key Features

  • 🎭 Seamless Twitch Integration – Viewers join the game with channel points, bits, subs, or gifted subs. No extra setup required!

  • 🏆 Battle for the Throne – Earn points in a Plinko-style challenge and spend them to attack or defend the throne.

  • 🔄 Automatic Engagement – No need to manage the game yourself—it runs in the background while you stream.

  • 🛠 Fully Customizable – Adjust commands, gameplay settings, and visuals to match your stream’s theme.

  • ⚡ Performance Optimized – Designed to scale automatically, even when running resource-intensive games.

  • 🏅 Leaderboards & Stats – Let viewers track their points, rank, and battle history with simple chat commands.

  • 🎯 Boost Monetization – Encourage bits and subs by making it more rewarding to join the fight for the throne.

  • 🎨 Transparent Overlay or Chroma Key – Customize the look and seamlessly blend the game with your stream.

Why Streamers Love It

✔ Engages lurkers – The throne mechanic keeps viewers invested, leading to longer watch times.
✔ Boosts revenue – An easy, fun way to encourage bits and subscriptions without extra effort.
✔ Runs automatically – Focus on your content while the game handles itself.
✔ Simple to set up – Just install, customize, and let your chat take over!

Get ready to crown a new king! Will your viewers rise to power or be overthrown?

Try King of the Chat today and watch your community come alive!
